user.title: Add a prayer times location
user.description:
Search for a city or town. Leave blank to use your home location.

Place search by [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com) (CC BY 4.0).

pick.title: Choose the location
pick.description: Several places matched. Pick one, or type a different name to search again.

location.title: Confirm the location
location.description: Prayer times are calculated by [Aladhan](https://aladhan.com) for this point. If you move the pin or edit the coordinates, the time zone is refreshed when you submit, so you can check it before saving. Update the name and method yourself if needed.

data_description.latitude: Editing the coordinates takes priority over the map pin.
data_description.name: Used for the device and entity names, for example "Dubai".
data_description.method: Suggested for the country. Use the authority followed locally so times match announcements.

location_updated.title: Check the updated details
location_updated.description: The location changed, so the time zone below was updated to match (unless you picked one yourself). The name and calculation method weren't changed. Check them all, then submit again to save.

data_description.latitude: Editing the coordinates takes priority over the map pin.
data_description.name: Used for the device and entity names, for example "Dubai".
data_description.method: Suggested for the country. Use the authority followed locally so times match announcements.

error.cannot_connect: Could not fetch prayer times from Aladhan for this location.
error.no_results: No places found. Try a different spelling or a nearby larger town.
error.search_failed: The location search service could not be reached. Try again, or leave the search blank to use your home location.
